opportunity: Unified identity + social + security + app launcher
decision: Make AuthLink the control plane, not a duplicate owner of all domain data
Every access carries purpose, scope, expiry, audience and audit
AuthLink owns internal graph; external networks are adapters/import-export only
Per-field policies; no all-or-nothing profile

opportunity: Security posture as first-class social identity
decision: Verified badge is derived from assurance, never reveals sensitive proof

opportunity: Password/passkey manager integrated with social identity
decision: OS credential-provider adapters + encrypted Vault
Import/copy selected assets into encrypted Vault; do not claim impossible OS-wide access
Deterministic policy first; ML assists, never silently blocks critical rights alone
Local discovery/link + E2EE envelopes + store/forward, permissions unchanged

opportunity: Social + business inbox with hard context separation
decision: One UI, separate organization scopes and retention
Source, license, author, evidence, version, jurisdiction, prerequisite graph
DAG of atomic steps, prerequisite routing and spaced review
Sell/license a path or expert session while keeping provenance and refund/escrow hooks
OS-native controls with child best-interest/privacy, not surveillance
User-controlled HealthKit/Health Connect/RNDS refs + routines/workouts/meds/cycles

opportunity: Finance health in same identity hub
decision: Open Finance consented projections; bank remains separate domain owner
Use authorized Login Único/Serpro/official APIs only; no scraping
Append-only journal + Merkle/hash anchoring; never raw PII/biometrics on-chain
Keep providers/MCP/modules/sequencer/notes/workbench as Developer mode
Export, consent withdrawal, retention policies and deletion workflows
